title: Heliocor
extract:
The Heliocor is a Cephalon-designed hammer obtainable from Cephalon Simaris. The immense power of the Heliocor not only lies in its high damage per swing, but its ability to aid the user in transferring slain enemies into their Codex (As well as being able to harvest Kavat Genetic Code from Feral Kavats). It does, however, suffer a little in the ways of status and has a reduced swing speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Crushing Ruin stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Synoid Heliocor for the second highest base damage of all hammers, behind  Arca Titron.
Second highest critical chance of all hammers, behind  Fragor Prime.

Acquisition
The Heliocor's blueprint can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for  75,000.

Notes
The Heliocor will not grant Standing for Cephalon Simaris even if players are carrying Synthesis Scanners in their Gear, though the weapon will still perform Codex scans as normal.
If the equipped Synthesis Scanner is enhanced with the Sol-Battery Widget, scans through melee kills will not use up scanner charges.
The Heliocor can obtain Kavat Genetic Codes if it kills Feral Kavats. This works even if the Feral Kavat's Codex entry has been fully researched.
The Heliocor cannot scan something that has already been scanned with a normal scanner.

Tips
It is recommended to take advantage of Fury or Berserker Fury to compensate for its low attack speed.

Trivia
It is the first melee weapon that can be obtained from any Syndicate.
Functionally, the Heliocor is the first Cephalon-designed weapon built primarily for combat in mind, as previous Cephalon weapons are essentially repurposed research devices. This is also the first weapon that fulfils a utility function outside of damage-dealing during gameplay.
Unlike the  Gammacor and the  Simulor, the Heliocor does not deal  Magnetic damage.
